items.original: EMFACE combines synchronized radiofrequency and HIFES energy to lift, tone and smooth the forehead and cheeks in a 20-minute session. No needles, no downtime.

items.original: As we age, facial muscle tone decreases, the face sags and expression wrinkles set in. EMFACE treats the cause, not just the surface: radiofrequency heats the dermis to build collagen and elastin while HIFES energy contracts the facial muscles thousands of times per session.

items.original: Applicators sit on the forehead and cheeks; it feels like a warm-stone massage with gentle contractions. You can go straight back to your day.
